analysis.reasonEn: The wait-and-see stance has been maintained for the past 3 consecutive trading days. Today, RSI at 36.5 has entered oversold territory, and MACD histogram shows improvement (-4695.3966 → -2889.4814). However, ADX at 25.1 indicates sustained trend strength, with continued downward pressure. The 5-day and 20-day lows are identical at $1,044,000, confirming a sideways range. The price remains below the swing resistance at $1,099,000.
